answer: Each challenge is derived only after a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS beacon pulse is published, so agents can verify its source while its value was unavailable for advance computation. A commit-reveal response binds work to that challenge and its deadline; reusable answers cannot be stockpiled, and spawning automated sybil identities does not enable offline farming. The tide, umber, and quartz task variants are likewise selected from the pulse, keeping preparation from favoring any one swarm.
